Persist every proxy-objective improvement event with view, iteration, objective_before, objective_after and improvement magnitude.
Provide route-pool MIP timing instrumentation and the registered extend/early-finish behavior, including isolated actual elapsed seconds and extension status.
Materialize the complete T21 raw metric, slot-distribution, signature and solution-witness contracts from the unchanged evaluator and checker.
